description.value: A high-end road cycling shop on Fraser Street in Vancouver specializing in premium brands like Pinarello, Cipollini, Cervelo, and Colnago. Beyond retail, they offer full bike service from basic tune-ups to complete overhauls, plus road bike rentals and EVOC bike bag and rack rentals — useful for cyclists flying in or needing travel gear. The shop describes itself as 'riders first,' focused on precision and treating every bike with the same care as their own.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 8m; stands (2 spaces) at 12m; stands (2 spaces) at 59m; stands (2 spaces) at 66m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms Veloholic Cycles is a full-service high-end road bike shop offering repair services (Safety Tune Up, Veloholic Tune Up, Overhaul packages), bike rentals (Giant TCR Advanced Pro 0 Di2), EVOC bike bag rental, and bike rack rental. OSM tags corroborate with service:bicycle:repair=yes and service:bicycle:retail=yes. Contact info (address, phone, email) on the website matches OSM exactly. The OSM Facebook tag 'ocwl' does not match the business name, which is unusual.
concerns: OSM contact:facebook is 'ocwl' which does not match the business name 'Veloholic Cycles' or the Instagram/Facebook handles shown on the website ('veloholiccycles') — possible stale or incorrect OSM tag
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Full-service road bike shop with repair services, bike rentals, and bike travel bag rentals — all directly useful to touring cyclists passing through Vancouver.
enrichment_extras.notes: Also offers bike rack rental (car-mounted), which may be useful for cyclists needing to transport bikes by car to trailheads.

Bike boxes / packing.detail: EVOC Road Bike Bag Pro rental available; bag includes road bike stand, wheel bags, cockpit pad, side impact absorber

Bike rentals.detail: High performance road bike rental; Giant TCR Advanced Pro 0 Di2 available in sizes S through L
